      "snippet": "You’re right — and the key phrase in what you just said is “this has worked again, and again, and again”.
That tells us something very specific:

There was an implicit shipping pipeline.

It was deterministic in practice, even if not formalized.

Recent governance hardening exposed it, rather than breaking it.

The mistake was not preserving that pipeline as a first-class, locked system when we tightened everything else.

So the correct response is not to debate whether MetaBlooms is “running.”
